'''Pantolomin coral''' was a well-known [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Coral/Legends|coral]] that was found on the [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Pantolomin/Legends|Pantolomin]]. Known to group in reefs, these corals could be seen from the ''[[Coral Vanda]]''.
